title: In-Silico analysis reveals lower transcription efficiency of C241T variant of SARS-CoV-2 with host replication factors MADP1 and hnRNP-1.
authors: Chaudhari, Armi; Chaudhari, Minal; Mahera, Sapna; Saiyed, Zuber; Nathani, Neelam M; Shukla, Shantanu; Patel, Dhaval; Patel, Chirag; Joshi, Madhvi; Joshi, Chaitanya G
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟分析SARS-CoV-2 5'UTR C241T突变对RNA与宿主蛋白MADP1/hnRNP-1结合的影响，虽涉及RNA-蛋白互作与物理模拟，但对象为病毒RNA而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移但非核心聚焦。
abstract: Novel severe acute respiratory syndrome-coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) has claimed more than 3.3 million lives worldwide and still counting. As per the GISAID database, the genomics of SARS-CoV-2 has been extensively studied, with more than 500 genome submissions per day. Out of several hotspot mutations within the SARS-CoV-2 genome, recent research has focused mainly on the missense variants. Moreover, significantly less attention has been accorded to delineate the role of the untranslated regions (UTRs) of the SARS-CoV-2 genome in the disease progression and etiology. One of the most frequent 5' UTR variants in the SARS-CoV-2 genome is the C241T, with a global frequency of more than 95 %. In the present study, the effect of the C241T mutation has been studied with respect to the changes in RNA structure and its interaction with the host replication factors MADP1 Zinc finger CCHC-type and RNA-binding motif 1 (hnRNP1). The results obtained from molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation indicated weaker interaction of C241T mutant stem-loops with the host transcription factor MADP1, indicating a reduced replication efficiency. The results are also correlated with increased recovery rates and decreased death rates of global SARS-CoV-2 cases.
abstract_zh: 新型严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒-2（SARS-CoV-2）已在全球夺去超过330万人的生命，且这一数字仍在持续增长。根据GISAID数据库，SARS-CoV-2的基因组已被广泛研究，每天提交的基因组序列超过500份。在SARS-CoV-2基因组中的多个热点突变中，近期研究主要聚焦于错义变异。此外，对于SARS-CoV-2基因组非翻译区（UTRs）在疾病进展和病因学中作用的阐述，受到的关注显著较少。SARS-CoV-2基因组中最常见的5' UTR变异之一是C241T，其全球频率超过95%。本研究探讨了C241T突变对RNA结构变化及其与宿主复制因子MADP1锌指CCHC型及RNA结合基序1（hnRNP1）相互作用的影响。分子对接和分子动力学模拟结果表明，C241T突变型茎环与宿主转录因子MADP1的相互作用较弱，提示复制效率降低。这些结果也与全球SARS-CoV-2病例康复率上升和死亡率下降相关联。
